rules.title: Prohibition of Unqualified Banking Verbs
rules.suggested_replacement: Partner with Acme Financial Technologies, an FDIC-insured banking partner.

source_citation.exact_quote: Marketing collateral must never instruct consumers to "bank on us" or imply Acme itself holds banking charters.

regulatory_statute.act_name: Federal Deposit Insurance Act & FDIC Rule Part 328
regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Civil Money Penalties up to $100,000/day + DOJ criminal referral
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Prohibits non-depository FinTechs and platform providers from using the verb 'bank' or misrepresenting depository insured status to retail consumers.

source_citation.exact_quote: All collateral must use the formal nomenclature: "Digital asset custody solutions".

regulatory_statute.act_name: NYDFS Virtual Currency Framework & SEC SAB 121
regulatory_statute.section_pin: 23 NYCRR Part 200 • SEC Staff Accounting Bulletin 121
regulatory_statute.enforcement_body: New York Department of Financial Services (NYDFS) / SEC
regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Civil fines up to $250,000 per violation; BitLicense revocation
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Requires clear distinction of custodial digital asset services and prohibits speculative slang in regulated retail financial collateral.

rules.title: Strict Ban on Performance Guarantees
rules.suggested_replacement: Historical projected APY; yields subject to market volatility.

source_citation.exact_quote: Copywriters must never use the phrase "guaranteed returns", "risk-free yield", or "guaranteed APY".

regulatory_statute.act_name: Investment Advisers Act § 206(4) & SEC Marketing Rule
regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Disgorgement of fees + civil penalties up to $1,000,000+ per violation; advisory bar
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Strict prohibition on promising or guaranteeing specific investment yields, risk-free returns, or unsubstantiated APYs in public investor communications.

rules.title: Loan Approval Speed Disclosures
rules.suggested_replacement: Pre-qualified digital underwriting in as little as 3 minutes.

source_citation.exact_quote: The phrase "instant loan" or "instant approval" is deceptive and forbidden.

regulatory_statute.act_name: Truth in Lending Act (TILA) & CFPB Regulation Z
regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Civil money penalties up to $1,424,375/day for knowing UDAAP violations
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Advertising credit disbursement as 'instant' without clear qualification of underwriting conditions is classified as deceptive under federal consumer credit law.

source_citation.exact_quote: The brand name must strictly appear in Title Case as "Acme".

rules.title: Fee-Free Claims Qualification
rules.suggested_replacement: No monthly maintenance fees; other transactional charges may apply.

source_citation.exact_quote: Marketing text must never state "zero fees" without qualification.

regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Up to $51,744 per statutory violation under FTC Act Section 5
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Representing a financial product as 'zero fees' or 'free' when conditional interchange, wire, or third-party fees apply is deceptive unless conspicuously qualified.

rules.title: Educational Case Studies & Partner Portal Disclosures

source_citation.exact_quote: All educational case studies and technical thought leadership articles must display full state statutory disclosures prominently, except when published exclusively within verified enterprise partner portals.
Any marketing statement quoting system uptime, such as "99.99% uptime", must reference an active substantiated benchmark in the approved claims registry.

regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Cease-and-desist orders; up to $51,744/day civil contempt penalties
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Objective empirical performance claims must possess a verifiable reasonable basis before public dissemination. Expired audit reports cannot substantiate ongoing claims.

source_citation.exact_quote: Marketing text citing active customer scale (e.g., "Over 2 million active accounts") is verified through December 31, 2026.

regulatory_statute.act_name: FTC Act Section 5 Scale & Metric Verification
regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Up to $51,744 per violation; corrective advertising mandates
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Quantitative customer count representations require audited ledger verification to avoid deceptive metric inflation.

rules.title: Urgent Pressure Tactics & Fear of Missing Out (FOMO)
rules.forbidden_term: act now or miss out forever
rules.suggested_replacement: Explore our portfolio solutions at your convenience.

source_citation.exact_quote: High-pressure sales phrases such as "Act now or miss out forever!" or "Don't get left behind!" are strictly prohibited in public communications.

regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Up to $1,424,375/day civil money penalties for reckless or knowing abusive acts
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Prohibits artificial urgency, coercive countdowns, and dark commercial patterns that exploit consumer lack of financial understanding.

rules.title: Ban on Slang & Financial Colloquialisms
rules.suggested_replacement: Competitive interest rates on digital treasury solutions.

source_citation.exact_quote: The use of internet slang, hype terminology ("super dope yields", "moon shot", "HODL"), or excessive exclamation marks is prohibited across all corporate releases and landing pages.

regulatory_statute.act_name: Securities Exchange Act Rule 10b-5 & FINRA Rule 2210
regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Disgorgement, federal injunctive orders, SEC administrative sanctions
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Public communications regarding investments must be fair, balanced, and strictly avoid misleading hype, speculative slang, or frivolous financial claims.

rules.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) Contrast Standards

source_citation.exact_quote: All promotional text rendered across web and mobile surfaces must maintain a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against the underlying background surface to ensure legibility and compliance.

regulatory_statute.act_name: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Title III & WCAG 2.1 AA
regulatory_statute.enforcement_body: U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) Civil Rights Division
regulatory_statute.penalty_exposure: Civil penalties up to $111,614 for first violation, $223,229 for subsequent; injunctive orders
regulatory_statute.mandate_summary: Public commercial web and mobile interfaces must maintain a minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for standard text to ensure accessible communication for individuals with visual impairments.

approved_claims.claim_text: zero maintenance fees on digital treasury accounts
